x: This season we have also had our share of new promising youngsters joining this section, two of whom David Dyson and Dan Steward have already made their mark by contributing to our best result at Canvey Island.

16 year old John Warren, spurred on by the news that the Southern Counties had approved his first claim membership of Belgrave, ran a 4.13.0 1500m in this early season meeting. Equally creditable was the 4.37 run of 12 year old David Dyson (equal to a sub 5 minute mile).
